name: Tank 5 · SW corner
notes:
South-west corner tank, about 147 m: the highest point of the lot, on the fire side. Size: 5–10 kL.
Filled by a tee off Tank 1. It sits about 12 m above Tank 1 and above what the Bunyip can reach (82 m lift from the creek at about 54 m), so a small solar booster pump at Tank 1 lifts the last stretch.
Jobs: fire reserve with a 50 mm outlet and Storz fitting at the far corner of the west and south firebreaks; gravity-feeds the SW goat zone troughs and the W2 south-west pocket.
Drag it to the exact spot on site.
